name: Ceramic tile
description: Glazed ceramic floor or wall tile (e.g. 12x12), set in thinset mortar over cement board or a slab and grouted. Use a floor-rated tile on floors.
source: Daltile Memoir carton spec (build.com): 48.5 lb per 16.49 sq ft carton, about 2.94 psf (x 4.88243). Tile only; thinset and grout add about 1-2 psf.

name: Porcelain tile
description: Porcelain floor and wall tile (e.g. 12x24), denser and less absorbent than ceramic, so it suits wet areas and outdoor patios in freeze-thaw climates when rated for it. Set in thinset and grouted.
source: 12x24 porcelain box weights per 15.5 sq ft: TileBar Bronx White 51.9 lb (3.35 psf), Tile Shop Courtyard Sterling 58.7 lb (3.79 psf), Lowe's FLOORS 2000 Emperador 66 lb (4.26 psf); 3.8 psf used (x 4.88243).

name: Travertine tile
description: Natural travertine tile (12x12, 3/8in to 1/2in thick), honed or tumbled, set in thinset and grouted. Needs sealing; acidic cleaners etch it.
source: BuildDirect natural stone thickness guide: 3/8in stone tile about 5.5 psf, 1/2in about 6 psf; Marble Systems lists 3/8in tumbled travertine at 5.69 psf; 5.6 psf used (x 4.88243).

name: Thinset mortar (50 lb bag)
description: Polymer-modified thinset mortar for setting tile, sold in 50 lb bags. A bag sets about 60-65 sq ft with a 1/4 x 3/8in notched trowel; large tiles need more.
source: Estimate: 50 lb (22.7 kg) bag over a roughly 24x16x4in bag (0.025 m3). Coverage from the Custom Building Products VersaBond listing at Home Depot.

name: Sanded grout (25 lb bag)
description: Sanded cement grout for tile joints 1/8in and wider, sold in 25 lb bags. Seal it after it cures.
source: Estimate: 25 lb (11.3 kg) bag over a roughly 16x11x4in bag (0.0116 m3).
